# Cutcore Upholstery

> Independent upholstery workshop in Strydompark, Randburg, Gauteng, South Africa. Reupholsters, repairs and restores recliners, sofas, dining chairs, patio furniture and cane/wicker pieces for clients across greater Johannesburg.

Cutcore Upholstery is a family-run upholstery business offering honest, written quotes, hand-finished workmanship, and a 12-month workmanship warranty. The workshop is located at 282 Samantha St, Strydompark, Randburg, Gauteng 2194, and serves roughly a 50km radius including Boskruin, Bromhof, Bryanston, Rosebank, Melville, Sandton, Douglasdale, Randpark Ridge, Olivedale, Robindale, Roodepoort, Krugersdorp and Centurion.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.cutcoreupholstery.co.za/index.html): overview of services, service area and client reviews.
- [Services](https://www.cutcoreupholstery.co.za/services.html): detailed breakdown of recliner repair, sofa/couch reupholstery, dining chairs, cane/wicker re-caning, patio furniture, and bespoke cushions/slipcovers.
- [Gallery](https://www.cutcoreupholstery.co.za/gallery.html): before-and-after examples of completed work.
- [About](https://www.cutcoreupholstery.co.za/about.html): background on the workshop and its approach to quoting and repairs.
- [Contact](https://www.cutcoreupholstery.co.za/contact.html): quote request form, phone, email, WhatsApp and workshop address.

## Policies
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.cutcoreupholstery.co.za/terms.html): quoting, deposits, turnaround, warranty and liability terms.
